text: clean, easy to use. Bought these for a friend who uses the 4x6" recipe cards and likes these for covers as she can keep the card clean.  They are a thin, plastic and would wipe up nicely.  They arrived quickly (I have prime) and in good condition along with other  things I ordered.  I will update if there are any issues.
